mod.name: The Forgotten Weaponsmith
config.debuglogging.name: Enable Debug Logging
config.debuglogging.tooltip: Enables debug logging in the SMAPI console.
config.donatableicon.name: Donatable Icon Mode
config.donatableicon.tooltip: How the forge icon is displayed when hovering a donatable weapon.
config.forcedonationmenu.name: Force Donation Style
config.forcedonationmenu.tooltip: Forces a specific donation style. 'Regular' opens the donation menu at the desk. 'Android' shows a HUD hint to donate by clicking Werdon instead. 'None' auto-detects based on platform.
config.trackermenukey.name: Tracker Menu Key
config.trackermenukey.tooltip: Keybind to open the weapon donation tracker.
config.revealundiscoverednames.name: Reveal Undiscovered Names
config.revealundiscoverednames.tooltip: If enabled, shows the name of weapons you haven't donated yet instead of ???.
config.enableforgeexitoffset.name: Enable Forge Exit Offset
config.enableforgeexitoffset.tooltip: Disable if you experience screen flickering when exiting the forge.
config.tier2weaponupgrade.name: Tier 2: Weapon Upgrade
config.tier2weaponupgrade.tooltip: If disabled, Werdon's replicas will no longer have their stats boosted toward the strongest weapon of their type.
config.tier3forgeenchant.name: Tier 3: Forge Enchantment
config.tier3forgeenchant.tooltip: If disabled, Werdon's replicas will no longer receive a random forge enchantment.
config.tier4firstinnate.name: Tier 4: First Innate Attribute
config.tier4firstinnate.tooltip: If disabled, Werdon's replicas will no longer receive their first random innate attribute.
config.tier5donationscaling.name: Tier 5: Donation Scaling
config.tier5donationscaling.tooltip: If disabled, Werdon's replicas will no longer gain bonus damage and speed based on your total donations.
config.tier6secondinnate.name: Tier 6: Second Innate Attribute
config.tier6secondinnate.tooltip: If disabled, Werdon's replicas will no longer receive their second random innate attribute.
config.allowmoddedenchants.name: Modded Weapon Enchantments
config.allowmoddedenchants.tooltip: If enabled, modded weapons donated to Werdon can receive forge enchantments and innate attributes (stat boosts still remain vanilla-only).
config.allowmoddedstatboost.name: Modded Weapon Stat Boosts
config.allowmoddedstatboost.tooltip: If enabled, modded weapons donated to Werdon can receive stat boosts and donation damage scaling.
location.werdon.writing.unknown: Strange markings cover the back of the machine. You can't make them out.
location.werdon.writing.translated: In case of power loss: insert Fire Quartz into the central chamber.
location.werdon.activated: Something stirs within... Perhaps you should step outside and return.
location.jailbar.locked: Seems these bars won't move for you anytime soon...
dialogue_water_box: The water is somehow cold to the touch?
dialogue_anvil: You feel a tingle whenever you near the metal of the anvil!
dialogue_spare: Seems like it's been used for spares.
dialogue_statue: You feel watched by the statue.
dialogue_chest: This might have a use later.
dialogue_chest_ready: Place a weapon inside for Werdon to mess with.
dialogue_chest_skinned: This weapon's been touched by the forge already — Werdon won't take it.
dialogue_chest_confirm: Put your {{weaponName}} in the box for Werdon to reforge?
dialogue_chest_takeback: Take your {{weaponName}} back out of the box?
dialogue_chest_locked: Seems you need to buy the last weapon you left Werdon before he accepts a new one
dialogue_chest_not_donated: Werdon won't reforge a weapon he hasn't seen donated before.
menu.donate.title: Donate a Weapon
shop.desk.prompt: What would you like to do?
shop.desk.empty: Shop empty, check back in {{days}} days!
iteract.android: Donate Items by clicking Werdon with them!
werdon.intro.line2: Ah, the one who awoke my system. Thank you for the ignition.$2
werdon.intro.line4: Strange, you aren't of Dwarvenkind, but you can understand my dialect.$1
werdon.intro.line5: For reawakening me, I will provide an explanation of what you see before you.
werdon.intro.line6: I am named Werdon, I am an automated weaponsmith.
werdon.intro.line7: This forge was used during the war against the Shadowfolk, but it seems in my absence that war has ended.
werdon.intro.line8: It seems my data on weapon creation has been lost...$1
werdon.intro.line9: Perhaps you can be of assistance?$1
werdon.intro.line10: Bring me weapons and I can study them to regain my data.
werdon.intro.line11: Back in my prime I made powerful enchanted items. Perhaps that fancies you?$1
werdon.intro.line12: Excellent. Then I await your return.$2
werdon.active.line1: These weapons are catalogued and secured.
werdon.active.line2: My forge stands ready, as do I.
werdon.active.line3: I am capable of transmuting materials with gold.
hud.tiershop.tier1: Werdon has started forging replicas of your donations.
hud.tiershop.tier2: Werdon's replicas are coming out sturdier now.
hud.tiershop.tier3: Werdon has started working enchantments into his replicas.
hud.tiershop.tier4: Werdon's replicas are taking on attributes of their own.
hud.tiershop.tier5: Werdon's growing collection is sharpening his work.
hud.tiershop.tier6: Werdon's replicas are reaching their finest form yet.
hud.wishitem.set: Werdon notices your interest in the {{weaponName}}.
